QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] A Frozen Heart
QuestInfo.0: Ultimately, the reason the kingdom of the Lion King fell was not because of the Black Mage, but because of the Alliance. How could this be? Get the details from #b#p2161002##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161002# said you should try hunting the #rnearby #o8210005##k if you don't believe what happened with the Alliance. Most are the Lion King's minions, but there are also spies that were sent from the Alliance. He says some of these monsters will drop the #t4032838# item.\n\n#i4032838##t4032838#  #b#c4032838##k/10
QuestInfo.2: #p2161002# was right. Does that mean the Red Lion King is the victim here? #p2161002# shook his head when you questioned. He believes that the king should never have joined the Black Mage, no matter his reasons. However, the Lion King's rage doesn't seem entirely unreasonable...

0.0: Although the Black Mage had driven the world to darkness, our kingdom fell because of the Alliance against him.
0.1: It's a tragedy that shows what fear and pain can do to a person's judgment. #rEven so, I don't fully understand the Alliance's actions#k...
0.2: You find this hard to believe, don't you? But there is proof. Try hunting the #o8210005#. You'll find something... interesting.

yes.0: Most of these #r#o8210005##k were once the king's knights and soldiers, but some weren't. Some are spies from the Alliance. If you find #b10 #t4032838##k items, I think you'll understand.

no.0: Do you need more time to think? Take all you need, and come back when you're ready.

1.0: Ah, you've got the #t4032838#. Have you found enough of them? *sigh*... Looking at them makes me feel more sad than angry. All we can do is lay the king to rest...

yes.0: I can tell you feel sorry for the Lion King. But don't. I understand his rage and sadness, but it was worse to sell his soul to the Black Mage.
yes.1: I served him and called him king because I believed he had the strength to lead his people to a better life. I never wanted him to throw his soul away for revenge.
yes.2: Besides, he had his revenge. He attacked the Alliance using the power he gained from the Black Mage. But even now, his rage remains. It's time to break the cycle of hatred and revenge.

item.0: Have you found the #b10 #t4032838##k yet? Keep looking for #t4032838# by hunting the #r#o8210005##k.
